description.value: KJ Enjoy Garden Restaurant is a Chinese cuisine restaurant in Pitt Meadows serving a broad Cantonese and Szechuan menu spanning beef, chicken, pork, seafood, tofu, noodle, and rice dishes. It offers both dine-in and online ordering with pickup and delivery. Located on Harris Road, it sits near cycling corridors connecting Pitt Meadows to the Golden Ears and Pitt River recreational areas.
